verdicts.reason: A shrinks the hero product can to a tiny icon jammed in the bottom-left corner, so the key product imagery is effectively gone. Its glow panel is an empty box, and the orange CTA collides with the detached maroon circle. B keeps the can with its label on the circle, but the starfield glow panel floats empty on the left, the can is undersized, and the circle crowds and overlaps the CTA at the bottom edge.

A keeps the product can at a readable size, but it floats unanchored on the left with the circle cut off from it inside a separate image panel. The logo is off-axis from the left-aligned headline and the large lower area reads as scattered. B is the same broken layout as pair 1A: a tiny vestigial can icon in the corner, an empty glow box, and the CTA overlapping the stray circle.

A is the same broken layout again: the product is reduced to a speck in the corner, the glow panel is empty, and the CTA collides with the circle. B at least shows the can on its circle with a sensible top-to-bottom order, but the empty glow box at the top wastes the hero spot. The circle also crashes into the end of the headline ('nights'), and the can is small and pushed into the bottom-right corner.
